verdict.rationale: A government immigration service could plausibly offer a documented system-to-system channel for software, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only applicant-facing online applications, a consumer ID Check app, and email alerts. It contains no system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs, APIs, or published enrollment path for software integration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
